List of Unicode Symbols

Version: 18.0.0 Release date: September 16, 2026 Total number of characters: 172 808

Almost half a million symbols of all kinds, including arrows, mathematical signs, emojis, hieroglyphics, and ancient scripts, are available. Each symbol lies in its assigned cell in the table. Just scroll down to explore the whole variety of Unicode characters. Or use the block navigation on the right — each character block occupies its range in the table divided into 17 planes. Try for example. Hover over a character you like to see its name or copy it. Click on the symbol name and go to a separate page to study it.

What's new in Unicode 18.0 13,007 new characters including three scripts, nine emoji, and more
